E03 ran the real label-free ThresholdAllocator against LearnedAllocator at identical verifier calls (750 at 25%). The paired CI for learned minus threshold admitted is [+0.412, +0.491], so it favors the fixed rule. L3a and L3i agree. L3s also shows the later scaled-greedy edge spans zero. The baseline had no free labels, so the confound is controlled and W2 is false. Claim 3: every non-E01 entry reuses the E01 pool, with the same model, task and proxy, so none can trigger "killed". L3k's embedding gain of 0.002 comes from that same pool. No entry shows an AUC gain of 0.05 or a neighbor ratio of 1.5 or more, so claim 3 stays open and W3 is false.

E03 compares the learned allocator to the label-free ThresholdAllocator at identical 750 calls. Paired CI for learned minus threshold admitted rate is [+0.412, +0.491], favoring the fixed rule. L3a, L3i and L3s agree (L3p's brief pass did not survive L3s). So claim 2 is not_supported, and the free-label confound was controlled (E01's free-label baseline was replaced). Claim 3: every later entry uses E01's pool (same model, task and proxy), so no qualifying kill. L3k shows embedding AUC gain of about 0.002 on the same pool. No non-E01 entry shows a gain of 0.05 or neighbor ratio of 1.5. So claim 3 is open. The ledger never calls claim 3 supported.
